questions.question: Which of the following is a definition for the culinary term ‘Barquette’? (Select the one/s that apply)
options: French bread commonly served with appetisers
Large croutons served hot with warm salads
Small boat-shaped pastry shell to hold soft filling.
answer_texts: Small boat-shaped pastry shell to hold soft filling.

questions.question: Which of the following are examples of mise en place requirements for appetisers and salads? (Select the one/s that apply)
options: Conduct stocktake and submit food order to management
Assemble and/or set up required equipment and utensils
Clean, wash, trim and cut ingredients as required by the recipe
answer_texts: Assemble and/or set up required equipment and utensils
Clean, wash, trim and cut ingredients as required by the recipe

questions.question: Which of the following are protocols that need to apply to the plating for table service of appetisers for practicality of service and customer consumption? (Select the one/s that apply)
options: Balance the items on the plate for visual appeal in terms of shape and colour
Control portion sizes and items so all plates are identical for the same menu item
Arrange plating of appetisers so they look the same for the same menu items
Use different serviceware/plates for the same menu item for each guest.
answer_texts: Balance the items on the plate for visual appeal in terms of shape and colour
Control portion sizes and items so all plates are identical for the same menu item
Arrange plating of appetisers so they look the same for the same menu items

questions.question: Which of the following are possible service protocols when plating canapés for service on platters at a function? (Select the one/s that apply)
options: Double-stack canapés to give the platter height and an added dimension and eye appeal
Provide an assortment of canapés on each platter
Individual canapés should not touch each other
answer_texts: Provide an assortment of canapés on each platter
Individual canapés should not touch each other

questions.question: Which of the following protocols apply to the plating of a compound salad for table service in terms of practicality of service and customer consumption? (Select the one/s that apply)
options: Construct and garnish the salad in a bowl for service
Add dressing and/or garnish just before service
Place individual ingredients of the salad in separate bowls so guests can construct the salad to their liking/preferences
Ensure sufficient salad to cater for the number of guests at the table.
answer_texts: Construct and garnish the salad in a bowl for service
Add dressing and/or garnish just before service
Ensure sufficient salad to cater for the number of guests at the table.

questions.question: Which of the following protocols apply to plating a salad ready for gueridon service? (Select the one/s that apply)
options: Plate up one bowl of prepared salad for each guest at the table ready for them to eat
Plate up the ingredients of the salad on separate serviceware items for each ingredient without dressing or garnish
Plate up the dressing for the salad in a small jug
Plate up the garnish for the salad on a separate plate.
answer_texts: Plate up the ingredients of the salad on separate serviceware items for each ingredient without dressing or garnish
Plate up the dressing for the salad in a small jug
Plate up the garnish for the salad on a separate plate.

questions.question: Which of the following are appropriate environmental conditions for storing appetiser and salad products to ensure food safety? (Select the one/s that apply)
options: High risk/potentially hazardous foods must be stored under refrigerated storage at or below 5⁰C
Must be stored in clean, food-grade containers
Store food on the ground of storerooms or coolrooms because this will be colder than higher locations as hot air rises
Store salads with dressings added to allow the flavour of the dressing to permeate the ingredients.
answer_texts: High risk/potentially hazardous foods must be stored under refrigerated storage at or below 5⁰C
Must be stored in clean, food-grade containers

questions.question: Which of the following are appropriate environmental conditions for optimising the shelf life of appetiser and salad products? (Select the one/s that apply)
options: Store items at the appropriate humidity for the type of the item
Protect food from external damage and contamination
answer_texts: Store items at the appropriate humidity for the type of the item
Protect food from external damage and contamination

questions.question: Which of the following are examples of safe operational practices when using equipment to produce vegetable, fruit, egg and farinaceous dishes? (Select the one/s that apply)
options: Wear designated personal protective equipment (PPE) and clothing
Always wet/damp-down oven gloves/mitts before using them to handle hot items
Ensure all safety guards are fitted.
answer_texts: Wear designated personal protective equipment (PPE) and clothing
Ensure all safety guards are fitted.
